AttrPicklistExcludedValue.name: AttrPicklistExcludedValue
AttrPicklistExcludedValue.description: Represents the excluded picklist values for a product classification attribute or a product attribute definition.

AttributeId.description: The ID of the product classification attribute or the product attribute definition of the picklist data type.

AttributePicklistValueId.description: The ID of the attribute picklist value that’s excluded in the product classification attribute or product attribute definition.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date the excluded attribute picklist value was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: The date the excluded attribute picklist value was last viewed.

Name.description: The name of the excluded attribute picklist value.

OwnerId.description: The owner of the excluded attribute picklist value.

AttrPicklistExcludedValue.accessRules: Product Catalog Management must be enabled to access this object.
